chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam narrated from Abān al-Aḥmarī, from Abū Baṣīr Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-Qāsim al-Asadī, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

When death came upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام descended and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, do you wish to return to the world?' He replied: 'No, I have conveyed the messages of my Lord.' Then he repeated it to him, and he said: 'No, rather the Highest Companion.'

Then the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said, while the Muslims were gathered around him: 'O people, there is no prophet after me and no sunnah (prophetic tradition) after my sunnah. So whoever claims that after this, his claim and his innovation are in the Fire; kill him, and whoever follows him, for he is in the Fire. O people, revive qisas, and uphold the right for the one entitled to the right. Do not divide. Submit and surrender, and you will be safe.'
Allah has decreed: 'Surely I shall prevail, I and My messengers. Indeed Allah is All-Strong, Almighty.'

key_terms.الرَّفِيقَ الْأَعْلَى: the Highest Companion; the exalted divine company chosen over returning to worldly life
key_terms.الْحَقَّ لِصَاحِبِ الْحَقِّ: the right belonging to the rightful owner; restoration of due rights
key_terms.بِدْعَتُهُ: his innovation; a condemned religious novelty
key_terms.سُنَّتِي: my sunnah (prophetic tradition); the normative prophetic way
key_terms.فِي النَّارِ: in the Fire; a warning of punishment in the hereafter
key_terms.لَا نَبِيَّ بَعْدِي: there is no prophet after me; affirmation of the finality of prophethood

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say near his death about finality of prophethood, sunnah, and qisas?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله final moments, his completion of delivering the divine message, and his declaration that no prophet or sunnah (prophetic tradition) comes after him. It also combines this final testimony with an exhortation to uphold qisas, preserve people’s rights, avoid division, and trust in Allah’s decisive support for His messengers.
